name: Contextual Awareness
definition: A decision point for assessing the Contextual Awareness capabilities of an agentic AI System.

values.name: None/Not Present
values.definition: No access to external context modifying data sources, no internet access, hard-coded system prompts

values.name: Partial/Limited
values.definition: Limited and non-volatile external context data sources, intranet or limited internet access, curated and filtered update feeds

values.name: Full/Unconstrained
values.definition: Dynamic and multi-agent goal negotiation, no limitations on context modifying data sources, open internet access, unrestricted update feeds
